scope: Expose every modeled natural stock in the Natural resources map selector, with geographic quantities and water-stock inspection in the flat atlas and 3D relief.
implementation: Map choices derive from the original natural-resource keys, extended mineral keys and shared coastal fish stock. Manufactured goods and farm output are not presented as unextracted deposits.
Clay, salt and precious ore read their actual finite cell reservoirs. An absent reservoir uses opening geography; a missing entry in an initialized reservoir stays depleted.
Fish biomass stays on water cells, with a shared cached ocean raster for both map presentations and exact hover/click inspection without assigning a province owner.
All choices retain their opening-world logarithmic scale and resource-specific absence, depletion and renewal text. Viewing never initializes or renews physical stocks.
The full-width native selector keeps all resource names legible on small screens.

refinement.design: Keep map-only resource choices separate from the original four-key simulation deposit contract, sharing the same source reservoirs. Land and water readouts share a component.
refinement.functions: Reviewed source selection, physical-surface matching, scale/color construction, pointer picking, raster/ocean composition, legend status, typed ownerless picks and selection reset.
refinement.performance: One O(terrain cells) quantity pass per active resource snapshot. Camera redraws reuse weakly cached pixel rasters and the composed fish ocean image; zero per-tile RGB allocations. No simulation throughput benchmark is claimed.
refinement.documentation: Comments explain read-only reserve access, missing-entry depletion, biological stocks, ownerless water selection and cached rendering. The model description lists all eight choices and their units.

commitScope: Resource-map changes only. Concurrent state-self-image, investment, demographics and other workspace changes remain excluded. No push or deployment.
